title: Quehue letter requesting coordinated Q’eswachaka nomination
version: 5 February 2010 letter, English translation in UNESCO nomination supporting documents
lineage: Translation of community municipality letter in nomination file.

passages.note: A letter dated 5 February 2010 from the District Municipality of Quehue describes the annual three-day rebuilding of a grass-rope bridge through communal work by the four named communities. Its claim of 500-year continuity is a claim needing independent historical study.
